_about: This repository's exceptions to Tools/offboard/offboard.json: headers that aren't off-board headers though their name says so (not_offboard_refs), and off-board headers accepted on another connector, with the reason (connector_accepted).

not_offboard_refs.ACE|ACE SD Adapter Bottom|J7: STACK SD: a socket for the ACE SD Adapter Top's J8, which stacks on this board
not_offboard_refs.ACE|ACE SD Adapter Bottom|J9: STACK POWER: a socket for the ACE SD Adapter Top's J10, which stacks on this board
not_offboard_refs.ACE|ACE SD Adapter Top|J8: STACK SD: pins under the board, into the ACE SD Adapter Bottom's J7
not_offboard_refs.ACE|ACE SD Adapter Top|J10: STACK POWER: pins under the board, into the ACE SD Adapter Bottom's J9
